svg.title: Modal content depends on the specified continuum model
svg.desc: A cautious overview of field types that may appear in continuum wave models; no universal mode count or propagation speed is claimed.
svg.text: Wave modes depend on the complete model
Field count is not, by itself, a mode count or interface-system dimension.
Mechanical displacement; temperature joins when the coupled
Relaxation, phase-lag, thermal-displacement, memory, or fractional models
Thermal branches and their speeds/support depend on the selected
Electrical, porous, magnetic, or carrier fields alter the eigenproblem;
quasi-electrostatic models are not EM-wave models.
Additional kinematics or spatial operators change boundary data
No universal mode count, speed, attenuation, or interface-matrix size is asserted.
Derive and classify roots from the actual field equations and boundary conditions.
